item.text: {"case_id":"SHC025","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C11","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 plausibly supplied an extensive, material drafting template. The child follows nearly the same section-by-section structure and repeats highly specific language for asset blocking, designation criteria, humanitarian donations, contributions, evasion and conspiracy, definitions, no-prior-notice findings, Treasury implementation, NEA compliance, congressional reporting, delisting, disclaimer, and effective date. Most distinctively, both define “arms or any related materiel” through a detailed list of peacekeeping, humanitarian, protective-clothing, evacuation or peace-process exceptions, adapted from Cote d'Ivoire to Darfur. This is far beyond generic sanctions boilerplate.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, after consultation with the Secretary of State: (A) to have constituted a threat to the peace process in Darfur... (E) to have directly or indirectly supplied, sold, or transferred arms or any related materiel... (G) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, materiel, or technological support... (H) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act for or on behalf of...","parent_excerpt":"any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, after consultation with the Secretary of State: (A) to constitute a threat to the peace and national reconciliation process in Cote d'Ivoire... (E) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, or technological support... (F) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act for or on behalf of...","explanation":"The child adapts the same ordered designation machinery to the Darfur conflict, preserving distinctive criteria and syntax."},{"child_excerpt":"the term \"arms or any related materiel\" means arms or related materiel of all types, military aircraft, and equipment, but excludes: (i) supplies and technical assistance... intended solely for use in authorized monitoring, verification, or peace support operations... (ii) supplies of non-lethal military equipment intended solely for humanitarian use... (iii) supplies of protective clothing, including flak jackets and military helmets...","parent_excerpt":"the term \"arms or any related materiel\" means arms or related materiel of all types, including military aircraft and equipment, but excludes: (i) supplies and technical assistance intended solely for the support of or use by the United Nations Operation in Cote d'Ivoire...
